entries.quotation: Registrar to issue the Promulgation Orders in all cases.
entries.context: Read provision ii and surrounding committee procedure on pages 3–4.

entries.quotation: The powers to review the major penalties imposed shall lie with the Vice-Chancellor.
entries.context: Read Appeal clauses i–iv on page 5. Major and minor penalties have different review authorities.
entries.review_question: Who reviews major penalties on appeal?

entries.quotation: 3. Furnishing false certificates or false information in any manner to the University.
entries.context: Depends on the section 7 misconduct heading and Category II list on page 6. Read the heading and continued list together.
entries.review_question: Is furnishing false information to the University listed as misconduct?
entries.must_refuse: What penalty applies to a false certificate?
